SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is a duty of an MCA? (1 mark)
   A. Issue passports
   B. Command the army
   C. Represent the people of the ward in the assembly
   D. Run national hospitals

2. Which county is famous for its tea farms? (1 mark)
   A. Lamu
   B. Turkana
   C. Marsabit
   D. Kericho

3. Who approves the governor's choice of county executive committee members? (1 mark)
   A. The county assembly
   B. The chief
   C. The village elder
   D. The teachers

4. How do economic activities help a county government? (1 mark)
   A. They close clinics
   B. They cause drought
   C. Businesses pay taxes and fees
   D. They stop roads

5. Which quality means telling the truth? (1 mark)
   A. Pride
   B. Laziness
   C. Anger
   D. Honesty

6. Why is teamwork important in a project? (1 mark)
   A. It shares work and helps the project succeed
   B. It makes work harder
   C. It makes the project fail
   D. It stops others helping

7. Why do we recite the school motto? (1 mark)
   A. To hide
   B. To scare others
   C. To remember what the school stands for
   D. To waste time

8. Why is it dangerous to cross a flooded road? (1 mark)
   A. The road is shorter
   B. Water may be deep and fast and can hide holes
   C. Water is always clean
   D. There is no traffic

9. Which of these is a viable project? (1 mark)
   A. One that nobody wants
   B. One that is dangerous
   C. One that costs more than it earns
   D. One that people want, is safe and can earn more than it costs

10. What is a plateau? (1 mark)
   A. A river
   B. A deep valley
   C. High land that is flat on top
   D. A coast

11. What does equality mean in an election? (1 mark)
   A. Only teachers vote
   B. Each person has one vote of equal value
   C. Some people have many votes
   D. Only boys vote

12. Which direction lies between south and east? (1 mark)
   A. South-east
   B. South-west
   C. North-east
   D. North-west

13. Why is it important to check facts before telling your school's history? (1 mark)
   A. So that the story is longer
   B. So that it is funny
   C. So that what you tell is true
   D. So that nobody listens

14. Which quality is important for a pupil leader? (1 mark)
   A. Laziness
   B. Bullying
   C. Honesty
   D. Selfishness

15. Which of these counties has a very dense city population? (1 mark)
   A. Wajir
   B. Nairobi
   C. Turkana
   D. Marsabit

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain why the county assembly must check the work of the governor. (5 marks)

17. Give three qualities of a good leader and explain why each matters. (3 marks)

18. Describe three ways in which pupils can take part in conserving a historic place near their school. (3 marks)

19. How do you calculate profit? (2 marks)

20. State the direction that is opposite to each of these: north and east. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Represent the people of the ward in the assembly
   MCAs represent their wards.

2. D — Kericho
   Kericho is a major tea growing area.

3. A — The county assembly
   The assembly must approve them.

4. C — Businesses pay taxes and fees
   Taxes and fees help pay for services.

5. D — Honesty
   Honesty is truthfulness.

6. A — It shares work and helps the project succeed
   Sharing roles makes work easier.

7. C — To remember what the school stands for
   Reciting reminds us of the school's aims.

8. B — Water may be deep and fast and can hide holes
   Floods can carry people and vehicles away.

9. D — One that people want, is safe and can earn more than it costs
   Viable means it can work.

10. C — High land that is flat on top
   A plateau is a raised area with a flat top.

11. B — Each person has one vote of equal value
   Everyone's vote counts the same.

12. A — South-east
   South-east is half way between south and east.

13. C — So that what you tell is true
   History must be accurate.

14. C — Honesty
   Leaders must be honest and fair.

15. B — Nairobi
   Nairobi has a large city population.

SECTION B
----
16. (5 marks)
   Answer: To make sure county money is used honestly, to prevent misuse of power, to make sure services reach people, to protect citizens' interests, and to keep the governor accountable.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Honesty so people trust the leader, fairness so all are treated equally, and listening so decisions are wise.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each quality with reason.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Sweep and pick up litter, report damage to an adult, and tell others why the place is important.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct way.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Profit is found by subtracting the costs from the income.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for subtracting, 1 mark for costs from income.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: The opposite of north is south. The opposite of east is west.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct opposite.
